source: 150 MeV proton point source, no energy spread, at z = -0.001 mm, direction +z (confirmed from the setup smoke output)
geometry: G4_WATER box x,y in [-60,60] mm, z in [0,300] mm; scoring bins 60 x 60 x 150 of 2 mm
materials: G4_WATER (Geant4 NIST material, I = 78 eV in Geant4 11)
cuts: 0.1 mm production range cuts for all particles; Geant4 default step limits
scorers: DoseToMedium (Gy) summed over histories, binary output
units: TOPAS binary scorer: Gy; header in dose.binheader
rationale: Performance calibration reference (single thread) for the proton-3d workload envelope and a first independent-MC proton depth-dose/lateral reference in water; execution success is not physics validation
